muse.rendering: Clickable tap-to-reply options, list / shopping cards, map, agenda, HTML widget. Agent picks from the IR; options are short labels, 2-4 per question.
muse.actions: Options send the label as the user's reply; product rows are links.

claude.rendering: MCP Apps (io.modelcontextprotocol/ui, text/html;profile=mcp-app, sandboxed iframe, platform-owned template, Allow/Always-allow prompt). Text fallback is mandatory — tools MUST return meaningful text content even when UI is available.
claude.elicitation: Form mode for one blocking choice/confirm (flat JSON Schema, enums); URL mode for payment/sign-in only. Claude Code supports form+URL; claude.ai web elicitation support is unverified — do not depend on it there.
claude.artifacts: Model-decided only. No tool or MCP server can request an Artifact.

grok.rendering: Markdown/text only. No documented rich-UI convention for third parties. No MCP Apps rendering, no elicitation, no Artifact/Studio request. Use the Markdown fallback below.

generic.rendering: Markdown/text only (same as Grok). Default when client capabilities are unknown.

presentation.client_detection: From MCP initialize capabilities: extensions['io.modelcontextprotocol/ui'] + mimeTypes containing 'text/html;profile=mcp-app' => MCP Apps capable; capabilities.elicitation form/url => elicitation capable; otherwise Markdown fallback. Never sniff User-Agent or model name.
fallback_rules: Text is the contract, UI is progressive enhancement. Every tool returns Markdown text + structuredContent (this IR).
One question per turn in text. Never present two option groups at once.
Numbered options, not buttons: '1. 手冲 — 喜欢花果香、清爽' and 'Reply with the number'.
Links, not embedded actions: product and checkout are plain Markdown links.
Totals verbatim, once: print the authoritative total; do not recompute or reformat it.
Confirm before money moves. Payment happens on the shop checkout page, never card details in chat.
Degrade the catalogue, not the truth: text shows at most 5 products; never truncate a price, stock status, or total.
do_not: Do not ship HTML/CSS/JS from a shop. MCP Apps HTML is the platform's sandboxed template, fed by structuredContent — never merchant markup.
Do not assume buttons, cards, or quick-replies exist. They exist only inside an MCP App iframe (Claude/ChatGPT) or as Muse options; everywhere else they are numbered text options.
Do not request a Claude Artifact or a Grok Studio canvas. No API exists; the model decides. Do not use the leaked <xaiArtifact> tag.
Do not use elicitation for sensitive data, payment credentials, or a catalogue/cart (flat schema only). Payment goes via URL-mode elicitation (Claude) or a plain checkout link (Grok).
Do not emit Adaptive Cards, Slack Block Kit, or Telegram keyboards to Claude or Grok — neither consumes them.
Do not put a fact only in the widget, only in an image, or only in a link destination. Price, stock, total, and policy are in the IR text too.
